title: 12 Top Picks for Your Chengdu Panda Adventure
description: Discover the best ways to experience giant pandas in Chengdu, from early morning visits at the Research Base to volunteer programs and other must-see city attractions.

places.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arrive right at opening (around 7:30 AM) to catch the pandas during their morning feeding and playtime.

places.name: China Conservation and Research Center for Giant Panda (Dujiangyan Base)
places.priceRange: Admission: CNY 58 (approx. $8 USD). Volunteer Program: CNY 700-1000 (approx. $97-138 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Consider participating in the full-day volunteer program for an unforgettable, immersive experience with the pandas.

places.name: Bifengxia Giant Panda Base (Ya'an Base)
places.priceRange: Admission: CNY 100 (approx. $13.80 USD) for scenic area, includes panda base.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Combine your panda visit with exploring the scenic canyon and majestic waterfalls within the Bifengxia Scenic Area.

places.name: Chengdu Zoo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Head straight to the panda enclosures early in the day for the best chance to see them active.

places.name: Panda Post Office (Chengdu Post Office)
places.priceRange: Cost of stamps/souvenirs vary, from CNY 5 (approx. $0.70 USD) upwards
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Send a postcard to yourself or a loved one with the special panda postmark as a unique souvenir.

places.name: Wenshu Monastery
places.priceRange: Free admission to monastery. Tea houses: CNY 20-50 (approx. $2.75-$7 USD) per person.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a cup of traditional Chinese tea in one of the monastery's tranquil tea houses for a relaxing cultural experience.

places.name: Jinli Ancient Street
places.priceRange: Food items from CNY 10-50 (approx. $1.40-$7 USD). Souvenirs vary.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a variety of Sichuan street snacks like San Pao Tai (three cannon ears, a type of mochi), Liang Fen (jelly noodles), or Long Chao Shou (wontons).

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley (Wide and Narrow Alleys)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Experience a traditional Sichuan ear-picking service or enjoy a cup of local tea in a classic tea house.

places.name: Haidilao Hot Pot
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for a yuan-yang pot (half spicy, half clear broth) to experience both flavors. Don't forget to customize your dipping sauce at the sauce bar.

places.name: Tianfu Square
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Catch the spectacular musical fountain show in the evening for a dynamic visual display.

places.name: Sichuan Museum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Allocate at least 2-3 hours to fully explore the diverse exhibitions, particularly the Ba-Shu bronze ware and Zhang Daqian's paintings.

places.name: Chengdu Museum (New Building)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the 'City History Hall' to understand Chengdu's transformation over millennia, including its famous tea culture and relaxed lifestyle.
